# Kyoto Family Trip Plan: 4 Days, 2 Adults + 1 Child

A balanced Kyoto itinerary with temples, kid-friendly meals, and one lighter walking day. Costs below are estimated for local transport, food, and entry only, staying within your **180,000 JPY** budget.

## Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary and Cost Plan

### Day 1: Arashiyama + West Kyoto
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Arrive and settle in; start with **Arashiyama Bamboo Grove** and **Tenryu-ji**.
- Afternoon: Cross **Togetsukyo Bridge**, then do a short riverside stroll or boat ride if energy is good.
- Food: Lunch of **yudofu** or soba; dinner with **udon**, grilled chicken, or set meals that work well for kids.
- Estimated costs:
  - Transport: **3,000 JPY**
  - Food: **14,000 JPY**
  - Entry: **2,500 JPY**
  - Day total: **19,500 JPY**
- Action: [Button: Arashiyama route](https://www.japan-guide.com/e/e3912.html)

### Day 2: Higashiyama Temples + Gion
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Visit **Kiyomizu-dera** early, then walk the historic lanes around the temple.
- Afternoon: Continue to **Sannenzaka / Ninenzaka** and end near **Yasaka Shrine** and **Gion**.
- Food: Try **matcha soft serve**, tofu dishes, and a family-friendly tempura or curry lunch.
- Estimated costs:
  - Transport: **2,500 JPY**
  - Food: **15,000 JPY**
  - Entry: **2,000 JPY**
  - Day total: **19,500 JPY**
- Action: [Button: Higashiyama guide](https://www.japan-guide.com/e/e3909.html)

### Day 3: Low-Walking Day — Kyoto Station Area + Train Museum
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/train-front.svg
- Morning: Keep it easy with the **Kyoto Railway Museum**.
- Afternoon: Move to **Kyoto Aquarium** or stay near Kyoto Station for shopping, rest, and indoor breaks.
- Food: Use the station area for easy lunches, bento, ramen, and dessert stops.
- Estimated costs:
  - Transport: **2,000 JPY**
  - Food: **13,000 JPY**
  - Entry: **5,500 JPY**
  - Day total: **20,500 JPY**
- Action: [Button: Museum options](https://www.kyotorailwaymuseum.jp/en/)

### Day 4: Northern Kyoto Temples + Relaxed Finale
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- Morning: Visit **Kinkaku-ji** for a classic Kyoto highlight.
- Afternoon: Choose a calm second stop such as **Ryoan-ji** or return to a favorite area for souvenir shopping and a slow lunch.
- Food: Last-day lunch with sushi, donburi, or a kid-friendly café near the temple route.
- Estimated costs:
  - Transport: **3,000 JPY**
  - Food: **14,000 JPY**
  - Entry: **1,500 JPY**
  - Day total: **18,500 JPY**
- Action: [Button: Temple loop](https://www.japan-guide.com/e/e3908.html)

## Budget Breakdown for the Full Trip

| Category | Estimated Cost |
|---|---:|
| Transport | 10,500 JPY |
| Food | 56,000 JPY |
| Entry fees | 11,500 JPY |
| Contingency / snacks / extras | 15,000 JPY |
| **Estimated total** | **93,000 JPY** |

## Family-Friendly Spending Notes

- This plan leaves a comfortable buffer under your **180,000 JPY** cap.
- The biggest savings come from using Kyoto buses/subway, choosing casual meals, and keeping one day mostly indoor/easy.
- If you want to upgrade comfort, the spare budget can cover a taxi on one temple day, a nicer dinner, or a better hotel location.
